summary.text: CeCe Harlin is the Republican candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 34 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Valdenia Winn (D).
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a lifelong Kansas City, Kansas, resident, medical professional and small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Harlin graduated from Schlagle High School and lists her profession on Ballotpedia as community advocate; she advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has more than 45 years of roots in Kansas City, Kansas, and is a caregiver and advocate as well as a medical professional and small business owner.

In the survey, Harlin named election integrity, taxation and public school leadership as areas of policy interest, and her key messages were "People Over Party" and opposition to taxation without representation.
